children: bioAffinity Technologies announced Hong Kong patent grant for its CyPath Lung technology, strengthening intellectual property protection in Asia.
Hong Kong Patent No. HK40048460 granted for system and method using antibodies, TCPP and flow cytometry to detect lung cancer in sputum.
Patent complements 2025 China patent and expands the company's Asian IP footprint to support market entry.
Patent covers core scientific foundation of CyPath Lung, the company's noninvasive test for malignancy assessment in lung nodules.
CyPath Lung has prior clinical performance: 92% sensitivity, 87% specificity, 88% accuracy and 99% NPV in published trial.
